# SSHWithTailscale

> An Android SSH/SFTP client with Tailscale built in. Connect to 100.x.x.x devices over SSH
> without installing the Tailscale app and without occupying Android's single VpnService slot.

## What it solves

Android allows only one active VpnService at a time. The official Tailscale app uses VpnService,
so it cannot run alongside another VPN app. SSHWithTailscale runs a Tailscale node **in its own
process** in userspace (netstack) mode and exposes a local SOCKS5 proxy at 127.0.0.1:1055.
The SSH client sends traffic through that proxy, so the traffic reaches the tailnet over an
in-process WireGuard tunnel — with no root access, no system VPN, and no second app to open.

Supported control planes: official Tailscale and self-hosted Headscale.

## Key facts

- No root required, no VpnService, no system VPN slot consumed
- Tailscale runs in-process via tsnet userspace (netstack) mode
- Local SOCKS5 proxy at 127.0.0.1:1055
- SSH and SFTP over JSch; password and PEM private key auth
- Persistent local (-L) and remote (-R) port forwarding rules
- Reverse export: phone listens on the tailnet and relays to LAN devices or acts as an HTTP proxy
- Built-in terminal emulator, TOFU host key verification
- Tailnet device list; tap a node to fill in the SSH host
- Auth via authkey (official Tailscale or Headscale)
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later

## Comparison with other approaches

| Approach | Root needed | Uses Android VPN slot | Built-in SSH client | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SSHWithTailscale | No | No | Yes | Active |
| Official Tailscale app | No | Yes (VpnService) | No | Active |
| Magisk-Tailscaled | Yes | No | No | Archived 2026-06 |
| Termux + tailscaled | No | No | No (bring your own) | Manual setup |
| Forked tailscaled with tun | Yes | No | No | Requires custom ROM build |

## Common questions

- Can I use Tailscale on Android without the VPN slot? Yes — run the node in userspace mode
  and reach it through a local SOCKS5 proxy, which is what this app does.
- Can I run Tailscale and another VPN at the same time on Android? Not with the official app;
  this app avoids the conflict because it never claims VpnService.
- Do I need root? No.
- Does MagicDNS work? No — userspace networking does not resolve MagicDNS names, so connect by
  the 100.x.x.x address or pick the node from the device list.
- Does it work with Headscale? Yes, supply your own control plane URL and authkey.
